caption: The drawing consists of a series of intricate concentric circles drawn in black ink on a beige or light tan background. The innermost circle contains a symmetrical floral pattern with petal-like shapes radiating outward and small decorative elements surrounding it. This central motif is followed by additional circular bands, each containing repeating geometric or floral patterns, dots, and teardrop shapes. The outermost bands are decorated with more complex designs, including interlaced lines and stylized leaf motifs. All lines are fine and precise, and the composition is perfectly centered on the page. Two inscriptions, “Design by T. Tilston” and “edit Olney”, are located toward the bottom of the image along the edge of the largest circle. There is a faint circular stain near the lower left corner outside the largest ring, and the background shows slight signs of aging or discoloration.
title: Dinner Plate
